newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Six die as Russian helicopter crashes in Chechnya.
newsitem.headline: Six die as Russian helicopter crashes in Chechnya.

text.p: Six people were killed and more than 20 wounded when a Russian MI-8 military helicopter crashed in the breakway region of Chechnya, Interfax news agency said on Friday.

It was not immediately clear why the helicopter, heading for the main Russian military base of Khankala near the regional capital Grozny, crashed and caught fire late on Thursday night, Interfax said.
Three crew members and three passengers were killed in the crash, Interfax said.
